For all other users that are affected by this bug, I have created a small python script that removes the duplicates from your mongo db. Use at your own discretion and use only if you know what it does, as this will edit your mongo db. It also can take quite a while to run when there are lots of duplicates
```
from pymongo import MongoClient
import pprint

# Replace the uri string with your MongoDB deployment's connection string.
uri = "mongodb+srv://<user>:<password>@<cluster-url>?retryWrites=true&writeConcern=majority"

client = MongoClient(uri)

# database and collection code goes here

db = client.ns0 # REPLACE ns0 with your database name!
collection = db.profile

prevStartDate = ''
for doc in collection.find():
    #pprint.pprint(coll.find_one(doc)) 
    profile = collection.find_one(doc)
    
    startDate = profile['startDate']
    if startDate == prevStartDate:
        print('duplicate found, removed!') 
        print('startDate: ' + startDate)
        collection.delete_one(doc)
    # We delete one by one so one original copy is still left..
    prevStartDate = profile['startDate']


# Close the connection to MongoDB when you're done.
client.close()
```
